name: Motive
description: Let your AI read your Motive fleet: where every truck and driver is, Hours of Service clocks and violations, inspection reports, safety events, fault codes, IFTA mileage and fuel purchases. Read-only, with a company API key.
instructions:
## Motive
This connector reads fleet data from **Motive** (formerly KeepTruckin) through its public REST API at `https://api.gomotive.com`: vehicles and their live and historical locations, drivers and other users, Hours of Service clocks, logs and violations, IFTA mileage, fuel purchases, inspection reports (DVIRs), safety events, fault codes, driving periods, trailers and other assets, and groups. Every tool only reads; nothing is changed in Motive.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. In the Motive dashboard open **Admin, Developers, API Access** (an admin role is needed) and create a company API key. Give it **read** access and the scopes for the data you want here (vehicles, locations, users, HOS, IFTA, fuel, inspections, safety events, fault codes, assets, groups). A key can also be limited to some groups; the AI then sees only those.
2. Copy the key from the one-time dialog and paste it into `MOTIVE_API_KEY`. It is sent as the `X-Api-Key` header. Keys expire on the schedule chosen at creation; Motive warns admins a week before.
3. Check the setup with `motive_list_vehicles`.

**Identifiers**: vehicles, users and assets have numeric Motive ids (`motive_list_vehicles`, `motive_list_users`, `motive_list_assets`). The unit number a dispatcher uses ("Truck 12") is the vehicle `number`; turn it into an id with `motive_lookup_vehicle`. Drivers are users with role `driver`.

**Dates, time zones and units**: date filters are `YYYY-MM-DD`; most reports default to the last 7 days. `updated_after` takes an ISO 8601 timestamp. Timestamps come back in UTC unless you pass `time_zone` (sent as `X-Time-Zone`); `metric_units` (sent as `X-Metric-Units`) switches between metric and imperial units. HOS durations in `motive_list_available_time` are seconds.

**Pagination**: list tools take `per_page` (default 25, at most 100) and `page_no`; each answer has `pagination` with `per_page`, `page_no` and `total`. Ask for the next page while there are more records than seen.

**Common workflows**
- Where is a truck: `motive_lookup_vehicle` or `motive_list_vehicles`, then `motive_list_vehicle_locations` (all ELDs) or `motive_list_vehicle_gateway_locations` (Motive Vehicle Gateway); the route over a period comes from `motive_get_vehicle_location_history`. Drivers and their vehicle: `motive_list_driver_locations`.
- Who can still drive: `motive_list_available_time`; compliance: `motive_list_hos_logs`, `motive_list_hos_violations` and unidentified driving with `motive_list_driving_periods` (assigned_to_driver false).
- Maintenance: `motive_list_inspection_reports` with status with_defects and `motive_list_fault_codes` with status open.
- Safety coaching: `motive_list_driver_performance_events`.
- Fuel tax: `motive_get_ifta_mileage_summary`, `motive_list_ifta_trips` and `motive_list_fuel_purchases`.
- Trailers: `motive_list_assets` and `motive_list_asset_locations`. Fleet structure: `motive_list_groups`. One record: `motive_get_vehicle`, `motive_get_user`.

**Limitations**: read-only by design; creating or editing vehicles, users, groups, geofences, fuel purchases or inspection reports, messaging drivers, dispatches and engine immobilizer commands are left out. Some data needs the matching hardware or plan (AI dashcam events, Vehicle Gateway locations, asset gateways). The location history endpoint accepts at most 10 simultaneous requests. Accounts on Motive's EU platform use a different host and are not covered.

MOTIVE_API_KEY.label: Company API key
MOTIVE_API_KEY.help: Motive dashboard: Admin, Developers, API Access, create a company API key with read access. The full key is shown only once.
MOTIVE_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key only, without spaces or a header name such as X-Api-Key.

verifyHints.401: Motive refused the API key. Check that it was copied in full from Admin, Developers, API Access, that it has not expired or been revoked, and paste it without the X-Api-Key header name.
verifyHints.403: The API key is valid but lacks the scope for this data. Create a new key with read access to the scopes you need (vehicles, locations, users, HOS and so on); Motive keys cannot be edited after creation.
verifyHints.404: No Motive record with that id. Use the numeric id from motive_list_vehicles or motive_list_users, not the vehicle number or driver name.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Motive is rate limiting this key. Wait a minute, ask for fewer pages, and try again.

tools.name: motive_list_vehicles
tools.description: List the company vehicles in Motive: id, number (the fleet unit name), status, VIN, make, model, year, license plate, fuel type, IFTA flag, groups, the ELD device and the current or permanent driver. Use it to find a vehicle id for the location, inspection, fault code and IFTA tools. Read-only, paginated.

driver_ids.description: Only vehicles linked to these driver (user) ids.

fuel_type.description: Only vehicles with this fuel type.

updated_after.description: Only records changed after this moment (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Useful for incremental syncs.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination.total; ask for the next page while page_no * per_page is below it.

time_zone.description: Optional time zone for the timestamps in the answer, sent as X-Time-Zone (for example "Eastern Time (US & Canada)" or "America/New_York"). Without it the company time zone applies.

metric_units.description: Optional, sent as X-Metric-Units: true returns kilometres, litres and metric units, false miles and gallons. Without it the company setting applies.

tools.name: motive_get_vehicle
tools.description: Read one vehicle by its Motive id: number, status, VIN, make, model, year, plate, fuel type, groups, ELD device and assigned driver. Read-only.

vehicle_id.description: Motive vehicle id (the numeric id from motive_list_vehicles, not the unit number).

time_zone.description: Optional time zone for the timestamps in the answer, sent as X-Time-Zone (for example "Eastern Time (US & Canada)" or "America/New_York"). Without it the company time zone applies.

metric_units.description: Optional, sent as X-Metric-Units: true returns kilometres, litres and metric units, false miles and gallons. Without it the company setting applies.

tools.name: motive_lookup_vehicle
tools.description: Find a vehicle by its fleet unit number (the "number" shown in the Motive dashboard, for example "Truck 12") and return its full record including the Motive id. Read-only.

number.description: Vehicle number exactly as set in Motive.

time_zone.description: Optional time zone for the timestamps in the answer, sent as X-Time-Zone (for example "Eastern Time (US & Canada)" or "America/New_York"). Without it the company time zone applies.

metric_units.description: Optional, sent as X-Metric-Units: true returns kilometres, litres and metric units, false miles and gallons. Without it the company setting applies.

tools.name: motive_list_vehicle_locations
tools.description: Current location of every vehicle (v2): for each vehicle its id, number, VIN and current_location with latitude, longitude, a place description, located_at, bearing, speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel level and the current driver. Use it for "where is truck X" or a fleet map. Works for all ELD types. Read-only, paginated.

vehicle_status.description: Only active or only deactivated vehicles.

metric_units.description: Optional, sent as X-Metric-Units: true returns kilometres, litres and metric units, false miles and gallons. Without it the company setting applies.

vehicle_status.description: Only active or only deactivated vehicles.

Each event has type, time, location, speed, driver, vehicle, coaching status and media links when recorded. Defaults to the last week. Read-only, paginated.

vehicle_ids.description: Only events in these vehicle ids.
